description: This file defines the Conditional class for handling conditional formatting rules within PhpSpreadsheet. It includes constants for condition types, operators, and time periods, as well as properties and methods for managing conditional formatting configurations and styles.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: Represents a conditional formatting rule, including condition types, operators, styles, and data bars used in Excel-like conditional formatting within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: getNoFormatSet
methods.description: Returns whether the noFormat property has been set.

methods.name: setNoFormatSet
methods.description: Sets whether the noFormat property should be set.

methods.name: getConditionType
methods.description: Retrieves the current condition type.

methods.name: setConditionType
methods.description: Sets the condition type for the conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: getOperatorType
methods.description: Retrieves the current operator type.

methods.name: setOperatorType
methods.description: Sets the operator type for the conditional rule.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the text associated with the condition.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text for the condition.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Determines if the rule should stop if this condition is true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets whether to stop evaluation if this condition is true.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of conditions.

methods.name: setConditions
methods.description: Sets the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds a single condition to the conditions list.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object associated with the conditional formatting.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style for the conditional formatting.

methods.name: getDataBar
methods.description: Retrieves the data bar configuration.

methods.name: setDataBar
methods.description: Sets the data bar configuration.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the conditional rule.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of this Conditional object.

methods.name: isValidConditionType
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid condition type.
